text: Day one. I start a small island that grows with my days.
Set up the project and wrote the first plan.
Long walk by the water. No screens.
Started a habit: 20 minutes of reading before bed.
Read about agent workflows and tried one on a toy repo.
Slow Sunday. Cooked a big dinner.
Picked the game idea and drew the first island.
Seven days of reading in a row.
Chose the camera: behind the character, with a zoom-out.
Created the repository and pushed the first commit.
